Crank Arm Wednesday Bike Ride

Raleigh, NC · Warehouse District · Social

No-drop

Crank Arm Wednesday Bike Ride is a social group ride in Raleigh, NC. It rolls every Wednesday at 7:00 pm from Crank Arm Brewing. About 10–15 miles. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Crank Arm Wednesday Bike Ride group ride

A weekly no-drop ride from the bike-themed brewery in the Warehouse District. About an hour on the bike. Lights and helmets are required.
